turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of the situation. Your visit suggests that the matter cannot be resolved without our assistance.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that I may have already said too much, gentlemen. I beg of you, please, you must understand the gravity of the situation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must insist that you reveal to me the nature of this urgent matter, for I can perceive that your distress is not merely a matter of royal protocol, but rather one that touches upon the very fabric of international politics.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am caught in a web of intrigue, gentlemen. I fear that my position, my family's honor, and the very stability of Europe may be at risk.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must confess that I find the situation increasingly puzzling. Might I inquire as to the nature of this 'intrigue' in which you find yourself entangled?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I may have compromised my family's position by involving myself with a... a lady of ill repute, and now she threatens to reveal a dark secret that could ruin my reputation and my country's relations with Europe.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I find this revelation quite astonishing. Might I ask, what exactly is the nature of this 'dark secret' that this lady threatens to reveal?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I must confess, gentlemen, that I am at a loss as to how to extricate myself from this predicament, and the stakes are far greater than I dare mention.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your predicament is indeed a complex one. Tell me, what is the nature of this lady's claim, and what evidence, if any, does she possess to support her allegations?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Ah, Your Majesty, I observe that the lady in question must possess some quite incriminating information to be able to wield such leverage over you. Might I inquire as to the nature of your relationship with her, and what, in your estimation, she could possibly know that would compromise your family's position?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that I must tread with great caution in revealing the details of this affair, lest I inadvertently cause more harm to my family's reputation and the delicate balance of European politics.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I perceive that you, Your Majesty, are hesitant to reveal the details of this affair. I must insist that I require all the information, no matter how incriminating it may seem, in order to devise a plan to extricate you from this predicament.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your reluctance to share the details of this affair is quite understandable, but I fear that the longer we delay in uncovering the truth, the more precarious your situation becomes.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am willing to share certain... details with you, gentlemen, but I implore you to exercise the utmost discretion and secrecy, lest the consequences of this affair befall not only myself, but also those I hold dear.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that the truth is the only way to extricate you from this predicament. I will not rest until I have uncovered every detail, no matter how delicate or compromising. I assure you, my discretion is absolute.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I couldn't agree more, Sherlock. Your Majesty, I must assure you that we will do everything in our power to protect your family's reputation and the delicate balance of European politics.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must know, Your Majesty, what is the nature of this affair that threatens your reputation and the delicate balance of European politics.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that my situation is indeed precarious, and I fear that my very throne is in danger. I have reason to believe that a certain individual, one who has been a trusted advisor, has betrayed me and is now using this information to blackmail me.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Tell me, Your Majesty, who is this trusted advisor who has betrayed you, and what is the nature of the information they possess that gives them leverage over you?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, may I ask, how did you come to suspect this trusted advisor of betrayal?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
